about.bio: Applied AI Engineer with a track record across domains — speech evaluation for a US med-tech startup, GPU-accelerated biotech at Hummingbird Bioscience, computer vision at Tata Elxsi, and speech recognition research at VIT. I deliberately pick up new problem spaces and find where techniques transfer.

Optimising models and pipelines for real-world performance constraints
Taking research-grade ideas to working, measurable implementations
